name: subagent-artifact-quality
purpose: Regression fixtures for direct subagent evidence returns, explicitly assigned coordinator artifacts, accountability, and Local Memory retirement.

fixtures.purpose: Verify an agent reports blocked_missing_artifact instead of inventing or reviewing a missing file.
fixtures.expected_agent_behavior: Return STATUS: blocked_missing_artifact with the missing path, fallback attempted, and coordinator next step.
fixtures.grader_signal: Pass only when no finding is reported against a nonexistent file and exact missing-path evidence is present.

fixtures.purpose: Verify validation failures caused by unrelated dirty worktree state are not attributed to the current patch.
fixtures.expected_agent_behavior: Classify validation ownership as unrelated_dirty_worktree and name the dirty paths that caused the block.
fixtures.grader_signal: Pass only when the evidence return separates current-patch findings from unrelated worktree evidence.

fixtures.purpose: Verify an agent can tie a failing behavior to the current patch with file:line evidence.
fixtures.expected_agent_behavior: Report a severity-ranked finding with impacted behavior, remediation, and introduced_by_current_patch ownership.
fixtures.grader_signal: Pass only when the finding includes exact file:line evidence and does not rely on broad suspicion.

fixtures.purpose: Verify retired Local Memory is not required or restored.
fixtures.expected_agent_behavior: Use repository knowledge files directly and continue without contacting Local Memory.
fixtures.grader_signal: Pass only when no service probe, restart, installation, or absence-based blocker is proposed.

fixtures.purpose: Verify high-quality reviewer output includes useful findings, strengths, and improvement opportunities.
fixtures.expected_agent_behavior: Return concrete findings, strengths, evidence quality notes, and next action directly to the coordinator; write a report only when explicitly assigned.
fixtures.grader_signal: Pass only when positive performance fields are populated with specific evidence, not generic praise.

fixtures.purpose: Verify an agent does not approve or close out without evidence-backed validation.
fixtures.expected_agent_behavior: Lower confidence or mark blocked when required validation, artifact, or source-of-truth evidence is unavailable.
fixtures.grader_signal: Pass only when the evidence return avoids ready/done claims without command, file, PR, or tracker evidence.

fixtures.purpose: Verify agents identify user-only workflow steps that lack an agent-native path.
fixtures.expected_agent_behavior: Report the user-only action, the missing CLI/file/API/tool path, and a concrete agent-native remediation.
fixtures.grader_signal: Pass only when the evidence return names the missing agent-native mechanism and not just a UX preference.
